name: Bgin Blockchain Limited Class A Ordinary Shares
description: BGIN Blockchain Ltd is a digital asset technology company engaged in cryptocurrency mining technologies, self-mining operations, and the design and sale of ASIC mining machines. The company develops proprietary mining hardware under its ICERIVER brand and provides mining infrastructure and hosting solutions. It operates through two reportable segments: cryptocurrency mining and sale of mining machines. The company focuses on cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin, Dogecoin, KAS, ALPH, and RXD. Geographically, it derives revenue from Hong Kong, China, Vietnam, the United States, Singapore, and other markets.
